description: Run one or more ops from list_edit_ops in order, as one undo step. Returns what changed (or why an op failed) and the new timeline. Times are seconds; clip ids come from get_project. Ops that only measure (loudness, scopes) return their data here too.

confirm.description: Set true to run ops that normally wait for a person’s click (delete everything, share).

project.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project
